Pets are welcome.

Welcome home to The Grafton, situated in the vibrant Yaletown area. This southeast-facing open-concept condo features laminate and tile flooring throughout and floor-to-ceiling windows that allow abundant natural light and fresh air to flow throughout the space. The living area features a cozy fireplace, while the spacious patio offers a lovely spot to unwind. The kitchen comes equipped with high-end appliances and marble countertops. Residents of The Grafton enjoy access to amenities including a rooftop garden and green space, a bike room, and a library.

Nestled in the heart of Yaletown and Downtown, you’re steps from beautiful parks, the seawall, and some of Vancouver's most popular cafes and restaurants. Start your day with a coffee at Analog Coffee before enjoying a relaxing stroll along the waterfront, watching the sunrise or sunset at George Wainborn Park or David Lam Park. Steps from Beach Ave, walk along the seawall to Sunset Beach, and relax while looking out over stunning water views. Indulge in incredible nearby dining at restaurants such as Au Petit Comptoir or Autostrada Osteria and end the evening with a show at the Queen Elizabeth Theatre. The Yaletown-Roundhouse Skytrain Station is steps away.

Please note: Leases are a minimum of a one-year fixed lease. Strata corporations may charge move-in/move-out fees, which are the direct responsibility of the tenant.
